heading: What Are Lipo-B (MIC) Injections, Really?
alt: A Lipo-B MIC injection holds methionine, inositol and choline, usually with B vitamins including B12

heading: What Lipo-B (MIC) Injections Are Not
alt: Lipo-B is nutrient support inside a supervised plan, not an FDA-approved weight-loss drug or a fat-melting shot

heading: Who Should Be Cautious or Avoid MIC/Lipo-B?
alt: Take extra care with Lipo-B if you have heart, liver or kidney disease, a psychiatric history, or ingredient allergies

heading: Beware of Unapproved "Fat-Dissolving" Injections Online
alt: The FDA warns unapproved fat-dissolving injections have caused infections, scarring and tissue damage; never self-inject

heading: What to Expect if You Start Lipo-B Injections
alt: Starting Lipo-B: a consultation with labs and other options, an intramuscular injection visit, then tracked follow-up

heading: The Different Types of Allergy Tests
alt: Three allergy tests: skin prick in 15 to 20 minutes, a blood IgE test in days, and a 48-hour patch test

heading: Preparing for Your Allergy Test Appointment
alt: Before an allergy test: tell your doctor about antihistamines, avoid named foods if tested, and wear short sleeves

heading: Treatment Options Post-Test
alt: Allergy treatment after testing: medications, immunotherapy shots for severe cases, and targeted avoidance

heading: Common Misconceptions About Allergy Testing
alt: Allergy testing myths: that it hurts, that only food causes allergies, and that testing is only for severe reactions
